frontier_scan.title: Scan frontier capabilities
frontier_scan.objective: Find capabilities/cost curves/standards newly practical in roughly the last 6-24 months.

trend_scan.title: Scan changing behavior and demand
trend_scan.objective: Find behavior, spending, regulation and workflow changes before products fully catch up.

technology_transfer.title: Transfer frontier capabilities across contexts
technology_transfer.objective: Map new capability across industries, jobs, workflows, customer groups, business models and distribution.

context_translation.title: Translate trend signals into new venture contexts
context_translation.objective: Recombine trend/behavior signals with new technologies and business models.

venture_imagination.title: Generate differentiated venture theses
venture_imagination.objective: Generate high-upside, non-obvious venture possibilities without pretending viability is proven.

eir_thesis.title: Shape investable initial venture thesis
eir_thesis.objective: Select and shape a serious thesis: enabling change, target context, buyer, why now, leap and key uncertainty.

capability_readiness.title: Assess capability and Skill readiness
capability_readiness.objective: Determine required domain knowledge, tools, sources, credentials and certified Skills before critique.

skill_forge.title: Acquire or build missing procedural capability
skill_forge.objective: Prefer existing Hermes Skills; otherwise build versioned DRAFT Skill with tests and failure modes.

skill_audit.title: Audit and certify candidate Skills
skill_audit.objective: Adversarially test Skill instructions, permissions, source use and failure behavior.

deep_research_lead.title: Decompose deep research dossier
deep_research_lead.objective: Fan research into technology, industry, customer, competition, regulation, economics and distribution with contrary coverage.

research_technology.title: Deep technology research
research_technology.objective: Establish enabling capability, maturity, cost and failure modes.

research_industry.title: Industry structure research
research_industry.objective: Map market structure, spend, incumbents, workflows and forces.

research_customer.title: Customer anthropology research
research_customer.objective: Distinguish user, buyer, approver, blocker; map triggers, pains, current behavior and trust.

research_competition.title: Competitive/substitute research
research_competition.objective: Find direct competitors, substitutes, incumbent responses and failed predecessors.

research_regulatory.title: Regulatory/trust research
research_regulatory.objective: Identify legal, regulatory, privacy, security and trust constraints without generic legal certainty.

research_economics.title: Economics and WTP proxy research
research_economics.objective: Estimate value pool, current spend, cost drivers, price hypotheses and economic risks.

research_distribution.title: Distribution research
research_distribution.objective: Identify credible first-10/100 customer channels and acquisition friction.

research_synthesis.title: Synthesize deep research dossier
research_synthesis.objective: Produce traceable dossier with support, contrary evidence, unknowns and recommended experiments.

contrarian_1.title: Contrarian review round 1
contrarian_1.objective: Find fatal premises and high-value weaknesses; refine rather than sterilize when uncertainty is testable.

venture_refine.title: Refine venture against valid criticism
venture_refine.objective: Change ICP, wedge, workflow, trust model, product, business model or distribution to absorb important critiques.

targeted_research.title: Resolve material research gaps
targeted_research.objective: Research only decision-relevant open concerns before second critique.

business_model_distribution.title: Finalize testable business model and distribution
business_model_distribution.objective: Define value capture, pricing metric, first-10/100 distribution and behavioral adoption model.

contrarian_2.title: Contrarian review round 2
contrarian_2.objective: Decide whether the refined business has earned the next unit of capital/learning.
acceptance: blocking vs experiment vs monitor classified

experiment_design.title: Design cheapest informative experiment
experiment_design.objective: Maximize information gained per SGD and time against principal uncertainty.

prototype_authorization.title: Evaluate prototype authorization
prototype_authorization.objective: Decide whether experiment information/commercial value justifies prototype resources without pretending G3 is proven.

product_design.title: Design experiment product workflow
product_design.objective: Define critical workflow and what not to build.

ux_design.title: Design testable user experience
ux_design.objective: Create minimal interaction design needed to test the workflow.

prototype_build.title: Build functional prototype
prototype_build.objective: Build functional prototype testing principal uncertainty within authorized budget.

prototype_qa.title: QA prototype against experiment
prototype_qa.objective: Break the prototype and verify it actually tests the experiment.

validation_package.title: Prepare commercial validation package
validation_package.objective: Prepare audience, hypothesis, prototype narrative, questions, disclosure and evidence requirements.

prospecting.title: Find real validation prospects
prospecting.objective: Identify real ICP prospects and relationship context without spam or invented data.

contact_guard.title: Review outbound eligibility
contact_guard.objective: Check opt-out, frequency, promises, sender reputation, disclosure and action authority.

customer_interaction.title: Run real customer validation interaction
customer_interaction.objective: Obtain genuine behavior/reaction/commitment under controlled authority; no fabricated evidence.

evidence_validation.title: Validate buyer evidence and evaluate strict G3
evidence_validation.objective: Apply deterministic evidence validator and strict G3 complete seven-tuple; research/prototype do not pass.

validation_refine.title: Refine after customer evidence
validation_refine.objective: Use actual customer response to refine/pivot/kill and design next experiment.

commercial_offer.title: Prepare real commercial offer
commercial_offer.objective: Create an honest offer and price; discounts up to owner policy, no autonomous binding LOI/pilot pricing beyond authority.

payment_or_commitment.title: Seek real commitment/payment
payment_or_commitment.objective: Seek authorized payment/commitment and capture provider receipt.

delivery.title: Deliver promised customer outcome
delivery.objective: Fulfill obligations reliably; track what was promised and delivered.

customer_success.title: Monitor adoption, retention and expansion
customer_success.objective: Measure onboarding, usage, health, retention, expansion and churn risk.

growth_loop.title: Run bounded growth experiments
growth_loop.objective: Test acquisition channels against CAC/contribution/retention under spend authority.

finance_close.title: Reconcile venture economics
finance_close.objective: Reconcile payments/costs, close financial snapshot and calculate unit economics.

post_g3_gate_review.title: Evaluate next G4-G10 capital gate
post_g3_gate_review.objective: Use imported exact Gate Policy and current evidence/financial snapshot to determine next resource commitment.

capital_allocation.title: Allocate next venture capital
capital_allocation.objective: Compare marginal expected value against portfolio opportunities and owner limits.

venture_strategy_review.title: Choose scale, continue, pivot or kill
venture_strategy_review.objective: Integrate evidence, economics, customer health and capital decision.

wind_down_preventure.title: Archive weak opportunity and capture learning
wind_down_preventure.objective: Release research/prototype capacity and preserve learning without pretending it became a venture.

wind_down.title: Safely wind down venture
wind_down.objective: Stop campaigns/commitments, honor customers, close finance, release resources and preserve learning.

historian_learning.title: Extract cross-venture learning
historian_learning.objective: Classify facts/priors/procedures/policy proposals and stage recursive learning safely.
